reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that alerts users when agent sessions require approval, answers, or plan review through banners, workspace indicators, sounds, and browser notifications.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中，当智能体需要审批、回答或计划审阅时，通过横幅、工作区提示、提示音和系统通知提醒用户。
summaries.en: Alerts DeepSeek Harness users when an agent needs approval, an answer, or plan review through banners, workspace indicators, sounds, and system notifications.

capabilities: Observes agent approval and interaction events
Maintains a deduplicated in-process alert log
Displays in-page banners and workspace status animations
Plays notification sounds through Web Audio
Sends browser system notifications and focuses the DSH page when clicked
Exposes alert details through a local web route or host RPC
